title: HTML receipt with the markup kept out of the Go file
task: Render an HTML receipt for an `Order{Customer string; Lines []Line; TotalCents int}` with `Line{Name string; Quantity int; Cents int}` in package `receipt`, using `html/template` so values are escaped: `Render(w io.Writer, order Order) error`. Keep the markup out of the Go source file. Amounts render as `12.34`.
